name: getuserfeedback
description: In-app surveys for SaaS teams. Your AI assistant sets up the ask, takes it live, and tells you what users said.

interface.longDescription: getuserfeedback.com is an in-app survey tool for SaaS teams. Create and improve flows, choose who sees them and when, and review responses through your getuserfeedback.com account.
defaultPrompt: What have my users been saying lately?
Create a short flow about my latest product launch.
Show me the feedback that needs attention.
